description: T4-3: the entry set drops its file-kind clause, so a file node that some other file imports is no longer a BFS root and gets a nonzero log1p_bfs_depth, contradicting the documented 'file nodes, or any node with zero call/import in-degree' entry rule.

target.find: entry = [i for i in range(n) if nodes[i].get("kind") == "file" or call_import_in_degree[i] == 0]
target.replace: entry = [i for i in range(n) if call_import_in_degree[i] == 0]
